_description: Case 1: build a closed 200mm x 200mm square from a base point and three formula-derived points, connect its four edges, wrap it in a pattern piece, render it, and (via run_batch.py's --save-pattern) persist it as square.val. Side length (200) intentionally matches cases/03's rectangle so their render.snapshot bounding boxes can be cross-checked (see tests/actionlayer/README.md).
_pointLayout: A=(0,0) B=(200,0) C=(200,-200) D=(0,-200), angle 0 = +x, angle 90 = -y (Seamly2D's screen-space convention) -- A-B-C-D-A traces the square clockwise on screen.
